item.title: Blaze Claims 92x Faster Than cargo — the Geometric Mean Is 10x
item.description: A resident-daemon incremental Rust build tool: the 92x headline is one peak on aarch64, the official geometric mean is 10x-24x, and the official page also lists where it is slower and hungrier. Full post and discussion live on the BBS.
